pandas.cut

pandas 3.1.1 · General functions · function

Assign numeric values to specified intervals or to a fixed number of equal-width bins.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

Call syntax

pd.cut(…) Full signature
pd.cut(
    x,
    bins,
    right=True,
    labels=None,
    retbins=False,
    precision=3,
    include_lowest=False,
    duplicates='raise',
    ordered=True,
)
